research_question: Did the promoted local RightBrain adapter receive contract-facing training examples that cover the currently active structured persona-policy payload, rather than only the older static surface contract?

hypothesis.claim_under_test: The documented contract-facing curriculum of the promoted v10 adapter does not cover every active field of the current conditional persona-policy payload and contains no row that jointly teaches conditional persona policy, semantic obligations, memory policy, forbidden markers, and procedural guidance.
hypothesis.scope_limit: A curriculum gap can justify constructing a new person-independent role-specialization curriculum, but cannot by itself prove that the gap caused model failures or that retraining will improve generation.

audit_design.current_reference: Generate the active legacy-JSON payload for all five frozen source-independent cases under both structured target and structured neutral persona providers without model inference.
audit_design.training_reference: Reconstruct every documented v8 and v10 contract-stage training source by exact Git blob and SHA-256, then parse only user payloads actually consumed by those stages.
audit_design.path_coverage: A current container or leaf path is covered only if the identical normalized path appears in at least one documented training payload.
audit_design.policy_value_coverage: For persona and audited-memory policy fields, a current scalar or list-item value is covered only if it appeared at the same normalized path in a documented training payload.
joint_row_requirement: conditional persona context and expression policy
leakage_checks: exact and normalized current user_input overlap
exact generated development output overlap with training targets
benchmark or expected-answer fields in current reference cases

decision_rules.source_reconstruction_pass: Every documented contract-stage source must match its frozen SHA-256 and row count.
decision_rules.measurable_current_contract_gap: At least one active persona-policy path is absent OR no documented training row satisfies the joint-row requirement.
decision_rules.development_separation_pass: All exact and normalized user-input overlaps, exact payload overlaps, and exact generated-output-to-target overlaps equal zero; current reference cases contain no benchmark item, target utterance, or expected reply.
decision_rules.authorize_person_independent_curriculum_: Source reconstruction passes, observed strict validity is below 9/10, a measurable current-contract gap exists, and development separation passes.
decision_rules.reject_curriculum_direction: All active persona-policy paths and values are covered and at least one joint contract row exists.
decision_rules.insufficient_evidence: Any source cannot be reconstructed, reference payload generation fails, or development separation fails.
